instruction: Navigate to the Drug Information A-Z directory page on Drugs.com.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the drugs.com homepage to the drug information database page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the active URL matches the expected drug information page. This is a simple navigation task similar in complexity to the original natural products database navigation.
metadata.verification_notes: The drug information database is a core feature on drugs.com. Task requires agent to find and navigate to this section from the homepage.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the navigation task: The getter extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, and the metric compares it with the expected URL using the is_expected_active_tab function.

Complete requirement coverage: The instruction requires navigating to the Drug Information A-Z directory page, and the evaluator checks exactly this by verifying the active URL matches https://www.drugs.com/drug_information.html.
All previous issues have been fixed: goto_prefix is now empty string to prevent URL duplication, the expected URL has been verified as correct, and the instruction has been clarified to be specific.
Correct data flow: The getter returns the URL as a string, the metric correctly handles both string and dict result types, and the compare_urls function properly compares the URLs.
Practical feasibility: The accessibility tree getter is reliable for extracting the Chrome address bar URL, and the URL will be visible after navigation completes.

changes: Changed goto_prefix from 'https://www.' to '' (empty string) to prevent URL duplication since modern browsers display the full URL including protocol in the address bar
Verified expected URL 'https://www.drugs.com/drug_information.html' is correct via web search - this is the actual Drug Information A-Z directory page on Drugs.com
Improved instruction from 'Go to the drug information database on Drugs.com.' to 'Navigate to the Drug Information A-Z directory page on Drugs.com.' for better clarity and specificity
validation_issues_addressed: URL prefix duplication - FIXED by setting goto_prefix to empty string
Expected URL verification - VERIFIED as correct
